title: एकषष्टितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 61 · Who was born as whom

summary.en: Vaishampayana tells which gods and demons took birth as the kings and heroes of the epic: Drona from Brihaspati, Ashvatthaman from Shiva, Bhishma from a Vasu, Kamsa and others from demons, Krishna as a portion of Narayana, Balarama of Shesha, Draupadi of Shri. Knowing these partial incarnations is said to keep one from despair.
summary.kn: ಯಾವ ದೇವದಾನವರು ಮಹಾಕಾವ್ಯದ ಯಾವ ರಾಜರು ವೀರರಾಗಿ ಜನಿಸಿದರು ಎಂದು ವೈಶಂಪಾಯನನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ: ಬೃಹಸ್ಪತಿಯಿಂದ ದ್ರೋಣ, ಶಿವನಿಂದ ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮ, ವಸುವಿನಿಂದ ಭೀಷ್ಮ, ದೈತ್ಯರಿಂದ ಕಂಸ ಮೊದಲಾದವರು, ನಾರಾಯಣಾಂಶದಿಂದ ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣ, ಶೇಷನಿಂದ ಬಲರಾಮ, ಶ್ರೀಯಿಂದ ದ್ರೌಪದಿ. ಈ ಅಂಶಾವತಾರಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದವನು ಕಷ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಗ್ಗನು.
summary.hi: वैशम्पायन बताते हैं कि कौन-से देवता और दानव महाकाव्य के किन राजाओं और वीरों के रूप में जन्मे: बृहस्पति से द्रोण, शिव से अश्वत्थामा, वसु से भीष्म, दैत्यों से कंस आदि, नारायण के अंश से श्रीकृष्ण, शेष से बलराम और श्री से द्रौपदी। इन अंशावतारों को जानने वाला संकट में नहीं घबराता।
summary.te: ఏ దేవదానవులు మహాకావ్యంలోని ఏ రాజులు, వీరులుగా జన్మించారో వైశంపాయనుడు చెబుతాడు: బృహస్పతి నుండి ద్రోణుడు, శివుని నుండి అశ్వత్థామ, వసువు నుండి భీష్ముడు, దైత్యుల నుండి కంసాదులు, నారాయణాంశతో శ్రీకృష్ణుడు, శేషుని నుండి బలరాముడు, శ్రీ నుండి ద్రౌపది. ఈ అంశావతారాలను తెలిసినవాడు కష్టాలలో కుంగిపోడు.
summary.ta: எந்தத் தேவர்களும் அசுரர்களும் காவியத்தின் எந்த மன்னர்களாகவும் வீரர்களாகவும் பிறந்தனர் என்று வைஶம்பாயனர் சொல்கிறார்: ப்ருஹஸ்பதியிடமிருந்து துரோணர், ஶிவனிடமிருந்து அஶ்வத்தாமா, வஸுவிடமிருந்து பீஷ்மர், அசுரர்களிடமிருந்து கம்ஸன் முதலியோர், நாராயணரின் அம்சமாக ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர், ஶேஷனிடமிருந்து பலராமர், ஸ்ரீயிடமிருந்து திரௌபதி. இந்த அம்ஶாவதாரங்களை அறிந்தவன் துன்பத்தில் தளரான்.
summary.ml: ഇതിഹാസത്തിലെ രാജാക്കന്മാരും വീരന്മാരുമായി ഏത് ദേവന്മാരും അസുരന്മാരും ജനിച്ചുവെന്ന് വൈശമ്പായനൻ പറയുന്നു: ബൃഹസ്പതിയിൽ നിന്ന് ദ്രോണർ, ശിവനിൽ നിന്ന് അശ്വത്ഥാമാവ്, ഒരു വസുവിൽ നിന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ, അസുരന്മാരിൽ നിന്ന് കംസനും മറ്റുള്ളവരും, നാരായണന്റെ അംശമായി കൃഷ്ണൻ, ശേഷനിൽ നിന്ന് ബലരാമൻ, ശ്രീയിൽ നിന്ന് ദ്രൗപദി. ഈ അംശാവതാരങ്ങൾ അറിയുന്നവൻ നിരാശയിൽനിന്ന് മുക്തനാകുമെന്ന് പറയപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.61; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
देवानां दानवानां च यक्षाणामथ रक्षसाम् ।
अन्येषां चैव भूतानां सर्वेषां भगवन्नहम् ॥

meaning.en: Lord, of the gods and Danavas, of yakshas and rakshasas, and of all other beings,

verses.text:
श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन मानुषेषु महात्मनाम् ।
जन्म कर्म च भूतानामेतेषामनुपूर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: I want to hear truly, in order, the births and deeds among humans of these great souls.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
मानुषेषु मनुष्येन्द्र संभूता ये दिवौकसः ।
प्रथमं दानवांश्चैव तांस्ते वक्ष्यामि सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Lord of men, I will tell you fully of those dwellers of heaven who were born among humans, and first of the Danavas.

verses.text:
विप्रचित्तिरिति ख्यातो य आसीद्दानवर्षभः ।
जरासंध इति ख्यातः स आसीन्मनुजर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: The bull among Danavas who was known as Viprachitti was born as the bull among men known as Jarasandha.

verses.text:
दितेः पुत्रस्तु यो राजन्हिरण्यकशिपुः स्मृतः ।
स जज्ञे मानुषे लोके शिशुपालो नरर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: Hiranyakashipu, the son of Diti, was born in the human world as the bull among men Shishupala.

verses.text:
संह्राद इति विख्यातः प्रह्रादस्यानुजस्तु यः ।
स शल्य इति विख्यातो जज्ञे बाह्लीकपुंगवः ॥

meaning.en: Samhrada, known as the younger brother of Prahrada, was born as Shalya, famed bull of the Bahlikas.

verses.text:
अनुह्रादस्तु तेजस्वी योऽभूत्ख्यातो जघन्यजः ।
धृष्टकेतुरिति ख्यातः स आसीन्मनुजेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: The radiant Anuhrada, known as the youngest-born, became the lord of men known as Dhrishtaketu.

verses.text:
यस्तु राजञ्शिबिर्नाम दैतेयः परिकीर्तितः ।
द्रुम इत्यभिविख्यातः स आसीद्भुवि पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: The Daitya called Shibi became a king on earth known as Druma.

verses.text:
बाष्कलो नाम यस्तेषामासीदसुरसत्तमः ।
भगदत्त इति ख्यातः स आसीन्मनुजेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: The best of asuras among them called Bashkala became the lord of men known as Bhagadatta.

verses.text:
अयःशिरा अश्वशिरा अयःशङ्कुश्च वीर्यवान् ।
तथा गगनमूर्धा च वेगवांश्चात्र पञ्चमः ॥

meaning.en: Ayahshira, Ashvashira, the mighty Ayahshanku, Gaganamurdha, and Vegavan as the fifth:

verses.text:
पञ्चैते जज्ञिरे राजन्वीर्यवन्तो महासुराः ।
केकयेषु महात्मानः पार्थिवर्षभसत्तमाः ॥

meaning.en: these five mighty great asuras were born among the Kekayas as great-souled, best of royal kings.

verses.text:
केतुमानिति विख्यातो यस्ततोऽन्यः प्रतापवान् ।
अमितौजा इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां सोऽभवन्नृपः ॥

meaning.en: Another powerful one, named Ketuman, became on earth a king called Amitauja.

verses.text:
स्वर्भानुरिति विख्यातः श्रीमान्यस्तु महासुरः ।
उग्रसेन इति ख्यात उग्रकर्मा नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: The glorious great asura named Svarbhanu became the king of terrible deeds called Ugrasena.

verses.text:
यस्त्वश्व इति विख्यातः श्रीमानासीन्महासुरः ।
अशोको नाम राजासीन्महावीर्यपराक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: The glorious great asura called Ashva became a king named Ashoka, of great might and valor.

verses.text:
तस्मादवरजो यस्तु राजन्नश्वपतिः स्मृतः ।
दैतेयः सोऽभवद्राजा हार्दिक्यो मनुजर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: His younger brother, remembered as Ashvapati, a Daitya, became a king, the bull among men, Hardikya.

verses.text:
वृषपर्वेति विख्यातः श्रीमान्यस्तु महासुरः ।
दीर्घप्रज्ञ इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां सोऽभवन्नृपः ॥

meaning.en: The glorious great asura called Vrishaparva became a king on earth known as Dirghaprajna.

verses.text:
अजकस्त्वनुजो राजन्य आसीद्वृषपर्वणः ।
स मल्ल इति विख्यातः पृथिव्यामभवन्नृपः ॥

meaning.en: Ajaka, king, the younger brother of Vrishaparva, became a king on earth known as Malla.

verses.text:
अश्वग्रीव इति ख्यातः सत्त्ववान्यो महासुरः ।
रोचमान इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां सोऽभवन्नृपः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty great asura called Ashvagriva became a king on earth known as Rochamana.

verses.text:
सूक्ष्मस्तु मतिमान्राजन्कीर्तिमान्यः प्रकीर्तितः ।
बृहन्त इति विख्यातः क्षितावासीत्स पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: The wise and famed Sukshma, king, became a king on earth known as Brihanta.

verses.text:
तुहुण्ड इति विख्यातो य आसीदसुरोत्तमः ।
सेनाबिन्दुरिति ख्यातः स बभूव नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: The best of asuras called Tuhunda became a lord of men known as Senabindu.

verses.text:
इसृपा नाम यस्तेषामसुराणां बलाधिकः ।
पापजिन्नाम राजासीद्भुवि विख्यातविक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Isripa, the strongest of those asuras, became a king named Papajit, famed for valor on earth.

verses.text:
एकचक्र इति ख्यात आसीद्यस्तु महासुरः ।
प्रतिविन्ध्य इति ख्यातो बभूव प्रथितः क्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: The great asura known as Ekachakra became famous on earth as Prativindhya.

verses.text:
विरूपाक्षस्तु दैतेयश्चित्रयोधी महासुरः ।
चित्रवर्मेति विख्यातः क्षितावासीत्स पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: The Daitya Virupaksha, a great asura who fought in varied ways, became a king on earth called Chitravarman.

verses.text:
हरस्त्वरिहरो वीर आसीद्यो दानवोत्तमः ।
सुवास्तुरिति विख्यातः स जज्ञे मनुजर्षभः ॥

meaning.en: The hero Hara, a Danava, slayer of foes, was born as the bull among men called Suvastu.

verses.text:
अहरस्तु महातेजाः शत्रुपक्षक्षयंकरः ।
बाह्लीको नाम राजा स बभूव प्रथितः क्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: Ahara, of great splendor, destroyer of enemy ranks, became a king famed on earth as Bahlika.

verses.text:
निचन्द्रश्चन्द्रवक्त्रश्च य आसीदसुरोत्तमः ।
मुञ्जकेश इति ख्यातः श्रीमानासीत्स पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: The best of asuras, Nichandra, with a face like the moon, became a glorious king known as Munjakeshi.

verses.text:
निकुम्भस्त्वजितः संख्ये महामतिरजायत ।
भूमौ भूमिपतिः श्रेष्ठो देवाधिप इति स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: Nikumbha, unconquered in battle and of great mind, was born on earth as the best of kings, remembered as Devadhipa.

verses.text:
शरभो नाम यस्तेषां दैतेयानां महासुरः ।
पौरवो नाम राजर्षिः स बभूव नरेष्विह ॥

meaning.en: The great Daitya asura named Sharabha was born among men as the royal sage named Paurava.

verses.text:
द्वितीयः शलभस्तेषामसुराणां बभूव यः ।
प्रह्रादो नाम बाह्लीकः स बभूव नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: The second of them, an asura Shalabha, was born as the king Prahrada Bahlika.

verses.text:
चन्द्रस्तु दितिजश्रेष्ठो लोके ताराधिपोपमः ।
ऋषिको नाम राजर्षिर्बभूव नृपसत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Chandra, best of the sons of Diti, like the lord of stars in the world, was born as the royal sage Rishika, best of kings.

verses.text:
मृतपा इति विख्यातो य आसीदसुरोत्तमः ।
पश्चिमानूपकं विद्धि तं नृपं नृपसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: The best of asuras known as Mritapa, know him, best of kings, as the king of the western Anupa country.

verses.text:
गविष्ठस्तु महातेजा यः प्रख्यातो महासुरः ।
द्रुमसेन इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां सोऽभवन्नृपः ॥

meaning.en: The greatly radiant great asura Gavishtha became a king on earth known as Drumasena.

verses.text:
मयूर इति विख्यातः श्रीमान्यस्तु महासुरः ।
स विश्व इति विख्यातो बभूव पृथिवीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: The glorious great asura called Mayura became a lord of the earth known as Vishva.

verses.text:
सुपर्ण इति विख्यातस्तस्मादवरजस्तु यः ।
कालकीर्तिरिति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां सोऽभवन्नृपः ॥

meaning.en: His younger brother known as Suparna became a king on earth named Kalakirti.

verses.text:
चन्द्रहन्तेति यस्तेषां कीर्तितः प्रवरोऽसुरः ।
शुनको नाम राजर्षिः स बभूव नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: The best of them, the asura named Chandrahanta, became a royal sage, a lord of men, named Shunaka.

verses.text:
विनाशनस्तु चन्द्रस्य य आख्यातो महासुरः ।
जानकिर्नाम राजर्षिः स बभूव नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: The great asura called Vinashana, of the moon, became a royal sage and lord of men named Janaki.

verses.text:
दीर्घजिह्वस्तु कौरव्य य उक्तो दानवर्षभः ।
काशिराज इति ख्यातः पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: The bull of Danavas called Dirghajihva, descendant of Kuru, became a lord of the earth known as the king of Kashi.

verses.text:
ग्रहं तु सुषुवे यं तं सिंही चन्द्रार्कमर्दनम् ।
क्राथ इत्यभिविख्यातः सोऽभवन्मनुजाधिपः ॥

meaning.en: The planet whom Simhika bore, who devours the moon and the sun, became a lord of men known as Kratha.

verses.text:
अनायुषस्तु पुत्राणां चतुर्णां प्रवरोऽसुरः ।
विक्षरो नाम तेजस्वी वसुमित्रोऽभवन्नृपः ॥

meaning.en: Of Anayu's four sons the best was the asura Vikshara, who became the radiant king Vasumitra.

verses.text:
द्वितीयो विक्षराद्यस्तु नराधिप महासुरः ।
पांसुराष्ट्राधिप इति विश्रुतः सोऽभवन्नृपः ॥

meaning.en: The second after Vikshara, lord of men, a great asura, became a king renowned as lord of the Pamsu country.

verses.text:
बलवीर इति ख्यातो यस्त्वासीदसुरोत्तमः ।
पौण्ड्रमत्स्यक इत्येव स बभूव नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: The best of asuras known as Balavira became a lord of men called Paundramatsyaka.

verses.text:
वृत्र इत्यभिविख्यातो यस्तु राजन्महासुरः ।
मणिमान्नाम राजर्षिः स बभूव नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: The great asura known as Vritra, king, became a royal sage, a lord of men, named Manimat.

verses.text:
क्रोधहन्तेति यस्तस्य बभूवावरजोऽसुरः ।
दण्ड इत्यभिविख्यातः स आसीन्नृपतिः क्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: The asura called Krodhahanta, his younger brother, became a king on earth known as Danda.

verses.text:
क्रोधवर्धन इत्येव यस्त्वन्यः परिकीर्तितः ।
दण्डधार इति ख्यातः सोऽभवन्मनुजेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: The other, named Krodhavardhana, became a lord of men known as Dandadhara.

verses.text:
कालकायास्तु ये पुत्रास्तेषामष्टौ नराधिपाः ।
जज्ञिरे राजशार्दूल शार्दूलसमविक्रमाः ॥

meaning.en: Eight of the sons of Kalaka were born as lords of men, tiger among kings, with valor like tigers.

verses.text:
मगधेषु जयत्सेनः श्रीमानासीत्स पार्थिवः ।
अष्टानां प्रवरस्तेषां कालेयानां महासुरः ॥

meaning.en: The best of those eight Kaleya great asuras was the glorious king Jayatsena among the Magadhas.

verses.text:
द्वितीयस्तु ततस्तेषां श्रीमान्हरिहयोपमः ।
अपराजित इत्येव स बभूव नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: The second, glorious, like Indra, was born a lord of men called Aparajita.

verses.text:
तृतीयस्तु महाराज महाबाहुर्महासुरः ।
निषादाधिपतिर्जज्ञे भुवि भीमपराक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: The third, great king, a great asura of mighty arms, was born as lord of the Nishadas, of terrible valor on earth.

verses.text:
तेषामन्यतमो यस्तु चतुर्थः परिकीर्तितः ।
श्रेणिमानिति विख्यातः क्षितौ राजर्षिसत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: The fourth of them was a best royal sage on earth, known as Shrenimat.

verses.text:
पञ्चमस्तु बभूवैषां प्रवरो यो महासुरः ।
महौजा इति विख्यातो बभूवेह परंतपः ॥

meaning.en: The fifth of them, the foremost great asura, was born here as a tormentor of foes known as Mahauja.

verses.text:
षष्ठस्तु मतिमान्यो वै तेषामासीन्महासुरः ।
अभीरुरिति विख्यातः क्षितौ राजर्षिसत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: The sixth of them, a wise great asura, became a best royal sage on earth known as Abhiru.

verses.text:
समुद्रसेनश्च नृपस्तेषामेवाभवद्गणात् ।
विश्रुतः सागरान्तायां क्षितौ धर्मार्थतत्त्ववित् ॥

meaning.en: Another king of that very host, Samudrasena, became famed on earth bounded by the sea, a knower of dharma and profit.

verses.text:
बृहन्नामाष्टमस्तेषां कालेयानां परंतपः ।
बभूव राजन्धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतहिते रतः ॥

meaning.en: The eighth of the Kaleyas, a tormentor of foes, named Brihat, was born a king of righteous soul, devoted to the good of all beings.

verses.text:
गणः क्रोधवशो नाम यस्ते राजन्प्रकीर्तितः ।
ततः संजज्ञिरे वीराः क्षिताविह नराधिपाः ॥

meaning.en: From the host named Krodhavasha, which I have told you of, king, heroic lords of men were born on earth.

verses.text:
नन्दिकः कर्णवेष्टश्च सिद्धार्थः कीटकस्तथा ।
सुवीरश्च सुबाहुश्च महावीरोऽथ बाह्लिकः ॥

meaning.en: Nandika, Karnaveshta, Siddhartha, Kitaka, Suvira, Subahu, Mahavira, and Bahlika;

verses.text:
क्रोधो विचित्यः सुरसः श्रीमान्नीलश्च भूमिपः ।
वीरधामा च कौरव्य भूमिपालश्च नामतः ॥

meaning.en: Krodha, Vichitya, Surasa, the glorious king Nila, Viradhama, descendant of Kuru, and Bhumipala by name;

verses.text:
दन्तवक्त्रश्च नामासीद्दुर्जयश्चैव नामतः ।
रुक्मी च नृपशार्दूलो राजा च जनमेजयः ॥

meaning.en: Dantavaktra by name, and Durjaya, and Rukmi, tiger among kings, and King Janamejaya;

verses.text:
आषाढो वायुवेगश्च भूरितेजास्तथैव च ।
एकलव्यः सुमित्रश्च वाटधानोऽथ गोमुखः ॥

meaning.en: Ashadha, Vayuvega, Bhuritejas, Ekalavya, Sumitra, Vatadhana, Gomukha;

verses.text:
कारूषकाश्च राजानः क्षेमधूर्तिस्तथैव च ।
श्रुतायुरुद्धवश्चैव बृहत्सेनस्तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: the Karushaka kings, Kshemadhurti, Shrutayu, Uddhava, Brihatsena;

verses.text:
क्षेमोग्रतीर्थः कुहरः कलिङ्गेषु नराधिपः ।
मतिमांश्च मनुष्येन्द्र ईश्वरश्चेति विश्रुतः ॥

meaning.en: Kshemogratirtha, Kuhara, a lord of men among the Kalingas, and the wise lord of men famed as Ishvara.

verses.text:
गणात्क्रोधवशादेवं राजपूगोऽभवत्क्षितौ ।
जातः पुरा महाराज महाकीर्तिर्महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Thus from the Krodhavasha host a crowd of kings was born on earth long ago, of great fame and great strength.

verses.text:
यस्त्वासीद्देवको नाम देवराजसमद्युतिः ।
स गन्धर्वपतिर्मुख्यः क्षितौ जज्ञे नराधिपः ॥

meaning.en: Devaka, who shone like the king of the gods, the chief lord of the gandharvas, was born on earth as a lord of men.

verses.text:
बृहस्पतेर्बृहत्कीर्तेर्देवर्षेर्विद्धि भारत ।
अंशाद्द्रोणं समुत्पन्नं भारद्वाजमयोनिजम् ॥

meaning.en: Know, Bharata, that from a portion of Brihaspati, the greatly famed divine sage, Drona Bharadvaja, born without a womb, was produced.

verses.text:
धन्विनां नृपशार्दूल यः स सर्वास्त्रवित्तमः ।
बृहत्कीर्तिर्महातेजाः संजज्ञे मनुजेष्विह ॥

meaning.en: He, the best knower of all missiles among archers, tiger among kings, of great splendor, was born among men from Brihaspati's line.

verses.text:
धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च यं तं वेदविदो विदुः ।
वरिष्ठमिन्द्रकर्माणं द्रोणं स्वकुलवर्धनम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona, whom the Veda-knowers know as the best in archery and in the Veda, equal to Indra in deeds, who increased his own family;

verses.text:
महादेवान्तकाभ्यां च कामात्क्रोधाच्च भारत ।
एकत्वमुपपन्नानां जज्ञे शूरः परंतपः ॥

meaning.en: from Mahadeva and Yama, from desire and anger, which had come together as one, was born the hero Ashvatthaman, a tormentor of foes.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा महावीर्यः शत्रुपक्षक्षयंकरः ।
वीरः कमलपत्राक्षः क्षितावासीन्नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: Ashvatthaman, of great might, destroyer of enemy ranks, lotus-eyed hero, was on earth, lord of men.

verses.text:
जज्ञिरे वसवस्त्वष्टौ गङ्गायां शंतनोः सुताः ।
वसिष्ठस्य च शापेन नियोगाद्वासवस्य च ॥

meaning.en: The eight Vasus were born as Shantanu's sons by Ganga, through Vasishtha's curse and Indra's command.

verses.text:
तेषामवरजो भीष्मः कुरूणामभयंकरः ।
मतिमान्वेदविद्वाग्मी शत्रुपक्षक्षयंकरः ॥

meaning.en: The youngest of them was Bhishma, who made the Kurus fearless, wise, a knower of the Veda and eloquent, destroyer of enemy ranks.

verses.text:
जामदग्न्येन रामेण यः स सर्वविदां वरः ।
अयुध्यत महातेजा भार्गवेण महात्मना ॥

meaning.en: He, best of all knowers, great in splendor, fought with the great-souled Bhargava Rama, son of Jamadagni.

verses.text:
यस्तु राजन्कृपो नाम ब्रह्मर्षिरभवत्क्षितौ ।
रुद्राणां तं गणाद्विद्धि संभूतमतिपौरुषम् ॥

meaning.en: King, know that Kripa, who became a brahmin sage on earth, was born from a host of Rudras, of great manliness.

verses.text:
शकुनिर्नाम यस्त्वासीद्राजा लोके महारथः ।
द्वापरं विद्धि तं राजन्संभूतमरिमर्दनम् ॥

meaning.en: The king in the world known as Shakuni, a great chariot-warrior, know, king, as Dvapara, born to crush enemies.

verses.text:
सात्यकिः सत्यसंधस्तु योऽसौ वृष्णिकुलोद्वहः ।
पक्षात्स जज्ञे मरुतां देवानामरिमर्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki, true to his word, bearer of the Vrishni family, was born from the wing of the Maruts, the gods, a crusher of foes.

verses.text:
द्रुपदश्चापि राजर्षिस्तत एवाभवद्गणात् ।
मानुषे नृप लोकेऽस्मिन्सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Drupada, too, a royal sage, was born from that same host, best of all who bear weapons, in this world of men.

verses.text:
ततश्च कृतवर्माणं विद्धि राजञ्जनाधिपम् ।
जातमप्रतिकर्माणं क्षत्रियर्षभसत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Know Kritavarman, king, as a ruler of men, an unrivaled doer and best of kshatriya bulls, born of the same.

verses.text:
मरुतां तु गणाद्विद्धि संजातमरिमर्दनम् ।
विराटं नाम राजर्षिं परराष्ट्रप्रतापनम् ॥

meaning.en: Know that the royal sage Virata, a crusher of foes who scorches other kingdoms, was born from the host of Maruts.

verses.text:
अरिष्टायास्तु यः पुत्रो हंस इत्यभिविश्रुतः ।
स गन्धर्वपतिर्जज्ञे कुरुवंशविवर्धनः ॥

meaning.en: Arishta's son, famed as Hamsa, was born the lord of gandharvas, who increases the line of the Kurus.

verses.text:
धृतराष्ट्र इति ख्यातः कृष्णद्वैपायनादपि ।
दीर्घबाहुर्महातेजाः प्रज्ञाचक्षुर्नराधिपः ।
मातुर्दोषादृषेः कोपादन्ध एव व्यजायत ॥

meaning.en: He was born as Dhritarashtra, known from Krishna Dvaipayana, long-armed, of great splendor, the lord of men with wisdom for his eyes; by his mother's fault and the sage's anger, he was born blind.

verses.text:
अत्रेस्तु सुमहाभागं पुत्रं पुत्रवतां वरम् ।
विदुरं विद्धि लोकेऽस्मिञ्जातं बुद्धिमतां वरम् ॥

meaning.en: Know Vidura, son of Atri, greatly fortunate, best of those who have sons, born in this world as best of the wise.

verses.text:
कलेरंशात्तु संजज्ञे भुवि दुर्योधनो नृपः ।
दुर्बुद्धिर्दुर्मतिश्चैव कुरूणामयशस्करः ॥

meaning.en: From a portion of Kali, King Duryodhana was born on earth, of bad mind and poor judgment, a source of ill repute for the Kurus.

verses.text:
जगतो यः स सर्वस्य विद्विष्टः कलिपूरुषः ।
यः सर्वां घातयामास पृथिवीं पुरुषाधमः ।
येन वैरं समुद्दीप्तं भूतान्तकरणं महत् ॥

meaning.en: He was hated by the whole world, a man of Kali; the lowest of men, who caused the killing of the whole earth, and by whom enmity was kindled that brought a great end to beings.

verses.text:
पौलस्त्या भ्रातरः सर्वे जज्ञिरे मनुजेष्विह ।
शतं दुःशासनादीनां सर्वेषां क्रूरकर्मणाम् ॥

meaning.en: The brothers, descendants of Pulastya, were all born among men here, a hundred beginning with Duhshasana, all of cruel deeds.

verses.text:
दुर्मुखो दुःसहश्चैव ये चान्ये नानुशब्दिताः ।
दुर्योधनसहायास्ते पौलस्त्या भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Durmukha, Duhsaha, and others not named were those Paulastyas, helpers of Duryodhana, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
धर्मस्यांशं तु राजानं विद्धि राजन्युधिष्ठिरम् ।
भीमसेनं तु वातस्य देवराजस्य चार्जुनम् ॥

meaning.en: Know King Yudhishthira as a portion of Dharma, Bhimasena as of Vayu, and Arjuna as of the king of the gods.

verses.text:
अश्विनोस्तु तथैवांशौ रूपेणाप्रतिमौ भुवि ।
नकुलः सहदेवश्च सर्वलोकमनोहरौ ॥

meaning.en: Likewise, of the two Ashvins were two portions, unequalled in beauty on earth: Nakula and Sahadeva, charming to all the world.

verses.text:
यः सुवर्चा इति ख्यातः सोमपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ।
अभिमन्युर्बृहत्कीर्तिरर्जुनस्य सुतोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: The powerful son of Soma known as Suvarchas was born as Abhimanyu, Arjuna's renowned son.

verses.text:
अग्नेरंशं तु विद्धि त्वं धृष्टद्युम्नं महारथम् ।
शिखण्डिनमथो राजन्स्त्रीपुंसं विद्धि राक्षसम् ॥

meaning.en: Know the great chariot-warrior Dhrishtadyumna as a portion of Agni, and know Shikhandi, king, who was a woman and then a man, as a rakshasa.

verses.text:
द्रौपदेयाश्च ये पञ्च बभूवुर्भरतर्षभ ।
विश्वेदेवगणान्राजंस्तान्विद्धि भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: The five sons of Draupadi, bull of the Bharatas, know them as the Vishvedevas.

verses.text:
आमुक्तकवचः कर्णो यस्तु जज्ञे महारथः ।
दिवाकरस्य तं विद्धि देवस्यांशमनुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: The great chariot-warrior Karna, born wearing his armor, know as the unsurpassed portion of the god Divakara, the sun.

verses.text:
यस्तु नारायणो नाम देवदेवः सनातनः ।
तस्यांशो मानुषेष्वासीद्वासुदेवः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: The one called Narayana, god of gods, eternal: a portion of him among humans was the powerful Vasudeva.

verses.text:
शेषस्यांशस्तु नागस्य बलदेवो महाबलः ।
सनत्कुमारं प्रद्युम्नं विद्धि राजन्महौजसम् ॥

meaning.en: The mighty Baladeva was a portion of the serpent Shesha; know, king, that Pradyumna, of great power, was Sanatkumara.

verses.text:
एवमन्ये मनुष्येन्द्र बहवोंऽशा दिवौकसाम् ।
जज्ञिरे वसुदेवस्य कुले कुलविवर्धनाः ॥

meaning.en: So, lord of men, many other portions of the dwellers of heaven were born in the family of Vasudeva, increasers of the family.

verses.text:
गणस्त्वप्सरसां यो वै मया राजन्प्रकीर्तितः ।
तस्य भागः क्षितौ जज्ञे नियोगाद्वासवस्य च ॥

meaning.en: The host of apsarases that I named was born on earth in part, by the command of Indra.

verses.text:
तानि षोडश देवीनां सहस्राणि नराधिप ।
बभूवुर्मानुषे लोके नारायणपरिग्रहः ॥

meaning.en: Those sixteen thousand women of divine origin in the world of men were taken by Narayana as his wives.

verses.text:
श्रियस्तु भागः संजज्ञे रत्यर्थं पृथिवीतले ।
द्रुपदस्य कुले कन्या वेदिमध्यादनिन्दिता ॥

meaning.en: A portion of Shri was born on the earth for delight: a blameless girl in the family of Drupada, from the middle of the altar.

verses.text:
नातिह्रस्वा न महती नीलोत्पलसुगन्धिनी ।
पद्मायताक्षी सुश्रोणी असितायतमूर्धजा ॥

meaning.en: She was not too short nor too tall, fragrant like a blue lotus, lotus-eyed, fair-hipped, with long black hair.

verses.text:
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्ना वैडूर्यमणिसंनिभा ।
पञ्चानां पुरुषेन्द्राणां चित्तप्रमथिनी रहः ॥

meaning.en: Endowed with all marks, bright like a cat's-eye jewel, she was one who in private unsettled the minds of five lords of men.

verses.text:
सिद्धिर्धृतिश्च ये देव्यौ पञ्चानां मातरौ तु ते ।
कुन्ती माद्री च जज्ञाते मतिस्तु सुबलात्मजा ॥

meaning.en: Siddhi and Dhriti, two goddesses, were the mothers of the five: Kunti and Madri were born as them; and Mati was Subala's daughter.

verses.text:
इति देवासुराणां ते गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा ।
अंशावतरणं राजन्राक्षसानां च कीर्तितम् ॥

meaning.en: Thus I have told you, king, the descent of portions of gods, asuras, gandharvas, apsarases and rakshasas,

verses.text:
ये पृथिव्यां समुद्भूता राजानो युद्धदुर्मदाः ।
महात्मानो यदूनां च ये जाता विपुले कुले ॥

meaning.en: and of the kings born on earth, arrogant in battle, and the great souls born in the wide family of the Yadus.

verses.text:
धन्यं यशस्यं पुत्रीयमायुष्यं विजयावहम् ।
इदमंशावतरणं श्रोतव्यमनसूयता ॥

meaning.en: This account of the descent of portions brings fortune, fame, sons, long life and victory; it should be heard without envy.

verses.text:
अंशावतरणं श्रुत्वा देवगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् ।
प्रभवाप्ययवित्प्राज्ञो न कृच्छ्रेष्ववसीदति ॥

meaning.en: Having heard of the descent of portions of gods, gandharvas and rakshasas, the wise one who knows origin and dissolution does not sink in hardships.
